decision: Low-risk designs skip Council entirely — Jury alone is sufficient and Council is not called at all (0 LLM calls from Council)
key_insight: Low-risk designs skip Council entirely — Jury alone is sufficient and Council is not called at all (0 LLM calls from Council)
alternatives_considered: Run a reduced 1-advisor + 1-reviewer panel for low risk
rejected_reason: A reduced panel still burns LLM calls and adds latency for designs that pose no real risk — hard skip is strictly better
